column4: Start with Requirements to trace BRD IDs into design, screens, components, work packages and tests.

Update amber backlog fields for assignee, state and estimate. Done does not automatically mean a release gate is accepted.
Close Decisions and Release Gates only with accountable owner review. Remaining gates stay visible even after tests pass.
Pass rate is a simple definition count, not a clinical or production-readiness score. Not applicable requires an approved scope decision.
